issues_detected.description: Series version numbering is non-monotonic: the current June 2026 release is 'Version 2.0' while the earlier October 2025 and June 2025 releases are each listed as 'Version 2.1' in version_access.versions_available; version_details explains that each quarterly release is a separate Dataverse dataset with its own version counter, but a reader comparing the list can misread 2.1 as newer than 2.0
issues_detected.recommendation: State per entry that version numbers are repository-internal to each release DOI, or add the release date beside each version string (partially done) and order the list explicitly by date

issues_detected.description: distribution_formats[1].access_urls is the Dataverse Data Access API base path (https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/api/access/datafile/), which does not resolve without a datafile id appended; the format text does explain it is the programmatic route for archives above the web download limit
issues_detected.recommendation: Keep the endpoint but state the id-appending pattern explicitly, or point access_urls at the release landing page and describe the API route in the format text only

issues_detected.description: Keyword list carries 'mass spectroscopy' (source term) where the technique is mass spectrometry, and the citation author list contains 'Ballllosero Navarro F' (likely source transcription artifact); both appear to be faithful transcriptions from the bundle
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain verbatim source terms but add 'mass spectrometry' as a keyword; verify the author spelling against the live Dataverse citation

issues_detected.description: publisher and last_updated_on are omitted although the citation names 'University of Virginia Dataverse' and maintainers[2] records the UVA Dataverse as archival host; the omission is disclosed in source_caveats ('The bundle names no publisher for the release') rather than silent, but the dedicated slot stays empty while the fact is carried elsewhere
issues_detected.recommendation: Record publisher as University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData) on the strength of the citation string, or keep the omission and its stated reason

issues_detected.description: Most of the 47 creators carry their institutional affiliation only as prose in notes; only the five University of Virginia authors (whose Dataverse listing prints a ROR URL) use the structured affiliations slot
issues_detected.recommendation: Promote the institution names in notes to structured affiliations entries so affiliation is machine-readable for all creators

issues_detected.description: preprocessing_strategies and labeling_strategies describe the MuSIC cell-map pipeline (node2vec, HPA image embedding, contrastive co-embedding, community detection, GO/Reactome + LLM annotation), while the release itself states computed cell maps are not included; every affected entry carries a source_caveat saying the step was not applied to the distributed artifacts
issues_detected.recommendation: Keep the entries with their caveats; when cell maps ship in a later release, attach this documentation to the distributed files

issues_detected.description: No errata field exists although source_caveats document that the three June 2026 immunofluorescence image archives report the same sizes as the October 2025 ones but different MD5 checksums (regenerated archives) with no repository erratum explaining the regeneration
issues_detected.recommendation: Record the observed regeneration as an errata/updates entry so the change is a first-class statement rather than a caveat

semantic_insights: The top-level identifiers agree end to end: id doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, doi 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, the citation DOI and version_access.latest_version_doi all name the same June 2026 release, and page resolves the same persistentId

Human-subjects logic is internally consistent: involves_human_subjects=false, direct_collection.is_direct=false with an explanation (all measurements on commercial cell lines from ATCC and HipSci), is_deidentified with the project's rationale (cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject), sensitive_elements_present=false with reasons, and confidentiality_level 'unrestricted' — Element 4 is therefore not applicable rather than failing

License semantics are coherent across four fields: license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, license_and_use_terms.data_use_permission=no_commercial_use, prohibited_uses restating the non-commercial and ShareAlike terms, and ip_restrictions naming the copyright holders (UC Regents, Stanford) who negotiate commercial licences under Data Access Committee supervision

NIH grant identifiers are valid and correctly stratified: full award string 1OT2OD032742-01, core project OT2OD032742 with supplement 3OT2OD032742-01S2, and Bridge Center award 5U54HG012513-02 all follow the NIH [type][activity][institute][serial] pattern

Cell line RRIDs (RRID:CVCL_0419 MDA-MB-468, RRID:CVCL_B5P3 KOLF2.1J) are well-formed Cellosaurus identifiers; ORCIDs are well-formed; nine authors without ORCIDs are given disclosed fragment identifiers minted on the release DOI rather than fabricated identifiers

Temporal ordering is coherent: award start 2022-09-01, data creation date 2025-02-27, release publication 2026-06-17, image archives 2026-07-15, award end 2026-08-31, quarterly augmentation through November 2026; the portal's conflicting 'Released on: June 17, 2025' is resolved against the higher-ranked Dataverse record and the resolution is recorded

related_datasets and version_access tell the same story: the four prior releases appear both as typed is_new_version_of relations and as versions_available entries, and the uncertain association of the May 2024 portal entry with DOI 10.18130/V3/DXWOS5 is flagged rather than asserted

Source conflicts are surfaced with declared resolutions in source_caveats (portal vs Dataverse dates, 563 vs 464 imaged proteins, SRA links vs embargo, AP-MS 'coming soon' vs shipped), including the decision not to carry protein counts onto regenerated image archives whose checksums changed

instances are ontology-grounded with B2AI_SUBSTRATE and B2AI_TOPIC identifiers per modality, and the project-wide portal totals (53,788 images, 21.4 TB) are quarantined in notes with an explicit scope warning rather than asserted at release scope

correctness_validations.url_validity: all well-formed; one access_urls entry is an API base path requiring a datafile id

strengths: Release-scoped identification done right: top-level id, doi, citation, page and latest_version_doi all name the same June 2026 release DOI, with a typed is_new_version_of chain to all four prior releases

Internally consistent non-human-subjects ethics posture: involves_human_subjects=false, direct_collection=false with explanation, de-identification rationale, sensitive_elements=false with reasons, confidentiality_level unrestricted and named ethics/governance contacts all agree

Unusually complete use guidance and limitations: intended, discouraged and prohibited uses all populated with sourced reasons, five typed limitations, two typed biases with a mitigation, and structured missing-data documentation

Rigorous source hygiene: date conflicts, protein-count conflicts, embargo changes and the regenerated image archives are resolved by declared source ranking in source_caveats, and unverifiable counts are withheld rather than guessed

Complete motivation and funding block with correctly stratified NIH identifiers (award, core project, supplement, Bridge Center U54) and a 47-author creator list with ORCIDs or disclosed minted identifiers
weaknesses: No variable-level metadata or tabular flag for any modality, and payload formats inside the ZIP archives are never named
No anomalies documentation for the data themselves; the observed archive regeneration (changed MD5s) lives only in source_caveats with no errata entry
Software tools carry no version numbers and are recorded in external_resources/preprocessing prose rather than a dedicated software slot
publisher and last_updated_on slots empty (disclosed as bundle gaps) while the hosting repository is documented in citation and maintainers
Creator affiliations are mostly prose in notes rather than structured affiliations entries
recommendations: Add variables (image channels, interaction table columns, perturbation matrix fields) and is_tabular per collection, and name the payload formats inside each ZIP archive
Record the June 2026 image-archive regeneration (same sizes, different MD5s) as an errata/updates entry rather than a caveat, and add an anomalies entry for any known data-level QC issues
Record tool versions (Cell Mapping Toolkit, FAIRSCAPE, node2vec, IMP) and move them into the dedicated software slot
Populate publisher with University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData) on the strength of the citation string, keeping the source_caveat about the bundle gap
Promote creator institution names from notes prose into structured affiliations entries, with ROR identifiers where resolvable
